source.title: The Dark Hoard
source.description:
The document is a report from one of Razorgore's underlings. There are rumors that some Blackrock orcs are hiding illicit magical artifacts in the storehouse. It is unclear whether this a simple smuggling operation, or something deeper.

Either way, it sounds like a lucrative score. Best go alone to avoid detection. No need to split the loot either.
source.objective: Break into the storeroom of Blackrock Spire, and steal whatever valuables are inside. You must complete the job alone.
source.completion: I can see now that you're not one of them. My apologies.
